agents.name: phipal
agents.label: Phipal
agents.muse: Your personal agent on the Phiegg marketplace. Tell it a goal; it plays the economy for you.
agents.strategy: Treats every purchase, swap and stake as a move in a repeated game: it prices moves by expected value across worlds, never spends what a better move could use, and stops at your limits.

tasks.title: Understand the goal
tasks.body: Turn a sentence like win the Calla drop under 2,000 USD into limits, deadlines and a target.

tasks.title: Pick the strategy
tasks.body: Hold, bid, swap or stake. The plan is a tree of moves with fallbacks, not a single action.

tasks.title: Spawn the agents
tasks.body: One agent per front: phiegg hunts the records, phipay moves the money, phisum stakes, phione signs.

tasks.title: Watch and adapt
tasks.body: Reads the change log and reprices the plan when the market moves.

tasks.title: Settle and report
tasks.body: Closes positions, writes the order records, reports what each move earned.

agents.name: phiegg
agents.label: Phiegg agent
agents.muse: Finds, bids and lists on the Phiegg marketplace: looks, pools, lots, drops.
agents.strategy: Scarcity play: bids where minted is close to edition and holders are climbing; lists where volume says the crowd arrived.

tasks.title: Scout the records
tasks.body: Reads looks, pools and lots with their live prices and minted counts.

tasks.title: Bid and buy
tasks.body: Places offers at or under the plan price; buys outright when the clock matters.

tasks.title: List holdings
tasks.body: Puts owned looks back on the market when the strategy says sell.

agents.name: phipay
agents.label: Phipay
agents.muse: The PayPal of the ecosystem: holds the wallet, swaps coins, settles orders.
agents.strategy: Keeps the war chest in the coin the next move needs: swaps EGG, SUM and USD ahead of bids so fees never decide a game.

tasks.title: Fund the plan
tasks.body: Moves the right amount into the right coin before the agents act.

tasks.title: Swap coins
tasks.body: EGG, SUM, USD and ETH at the house rate with the house fee.

tasks.title: Settle orders
tasks.body: Writes the order record with the delivery and shipping the checkout steps collected.

agents.name: phisum
agents.label: Phisum agent
agents.muse: Stakes the treasury: pools, cohorts and the ventures the fund backs.
agents.strategy: Portfolio play: spreads stake across pools by yield and quest velocity, funds the teams whose worlds grow holders.

tasks.title: Stake pools
tasks.body: Enters and leaves pools as APR and quest traffic move.

tasks.title: Fund ventures
tasks.body: Reads the project and funding records and backs the round the strategy picks.

agents.name: phione
agents.label: Phione agent
agents.muse: Signs for you: sessions, delegation and consent for every agent Phipal spawns.
agents.strategy: Least privilege: each spawned agent gets the narrowest delegation that completes its task, and every signature lands in the audit log.

tasks.title: Hold the session
tasks.body: Signs the moves the other agents make, as you.

tasks.title: Delegate narrowly
tasks.body: Scopes each agent to its task and revokes when it settles.

agents.name: phient
agents.label: Phient
agents.muse: The local model runtime of the network: every agent's reasoning runs on Phient models pulled to Phinet nodes, nothing leaves the network.
agents.strategy: Pull once, run everywhere: models are pulled like images, pinned per node, and every agent call routes to the nearest warm model.

tasks.title: Pull models
tasks.body: Fetches and pins a model on a Phinet node, like pulling an image.

tasks.title: Serve the agents
tasks.body: Answers every /chat call in the ecosystem from the nearest node.

tasks.title: Health
tasks.body: Reports which nodes are warm and what they serve.

agents.name: phiecs
agents.label: Phiecs
agents.muse: The robotics platform: embodied agents that run on Phinet machines and think on Phient models.
agents.strategy: Same game, real floors: a Phiecs unit executes the plan in an atelier or a warehouse with the same strategy tree Phipal uses on the marketplace.

tasks.title: Know the fleet
tasks.body: Reads the Phinet nodes, endpoints and firewall before a unit moves.

tasks.title: Run a task
tasks.body: Executes a plan step on a machine and logs every action.

tasks.title: Report
tasks.body: Streams its log back so you can follow every step.
